notes: NEW ✨ Suggest my work hours in the Class Schedule: pick a target — Light 12h, Typical 16h, or Max 20h — and the app fits work shifts around your classes for you.
Shifts keep 30 minutes of breathing room before and after every class, Sundays and meet days stay off, and you preview the whole suggested week before anything changes.
Tap Apply and the suggestion drops into your school planner with real start and end times — still yours to edit day by day.
